summary: Round 3 fixes two things and leaves the three that matter. Fixed: the table now shades as one flat tone, so the fan triangles from round 2 are gone. The rim chamfer is down to 0.18 mm and shows as a fine bright line in hero.png and stones.png. Worst draft is -0.75 deg (it was -0.97). Every gate the JSON records is green. Still wrong, for the third round running: (1) The washer and moat at the foot are still there. face.png shows a light rounded-rectangle lip, a dark moat inside it, then the drafted wall. stones.png shows the boss standing in a sunk pocket, with a hard outer wall on the right end and a stepped, jagged edge at the pocket's top-right corner. hero.png and bare-vs-finished.png show a plinth wider than the boss. (2) The facet is now four mirrored quarters. They make a sunk four-sided pyramid with its long axis round the ring. In hero-300 and hero.png one dark half and one light half read as a left-pointing arrow, the motif Logan rejected. In face.png and stones.png it reads as an envelope or a pyramid stud, which is exactly what round 2's acceptance test ruled out. (3) The lesson has grown from 8 features to 11. Frames 8 to 10 of timeline.png show near-invisible slivers, and frame 11 shows one bright triangle that does not match the four-tone pyramid in the finished renders. Frames 4 and 5 still look the same height. reverse.png still shows a two-tier bolt-head profile. The cartouche still reads, so the idea survives, but this is not a finished piece at the Caiman bar, and it is not a clear lesson. Round 3 is below 7.5, so the verdict is cut.
strengths: The one idea reads at 300 px: a raised, drafted rectangular tablet with rounded corners on a plain squared band. The theme runs face to palm, with nothing scattered.
Table tone is now even (round 2 punch #2 fixed). The 0.18 mm chamfer gives a single fine bright rim line in hero.png and stones.png.
Band edges are broken and the band no longer reads as cut sheet (palm.png). side.png shows a clean, true band with the tablet standing square at the crest.
report.json verdict_cause is a model explanation of 'castable with care': it gives drag on the bare band, the cartouche's vertical share, and the domed-band control.
Every gate is green and recorded, including cold reload, the template gate (1 patch) and the casting pattern.
